reviews.text:
Visited this store on June 14, 2025 to pick up some bags of salt and it will be the last time I visit this store after the experience my wife and I had.

The clerk in the store entered the wrong code for salt and the charge ended up being larger than I expected. I didn’t catch it till after two of my AccuBlue membership credits were used. Sara(h?) began to remedy the issue but during this process apparently ran into complications. As she’s working these issues out and getting visibly flustered during the process, four letter cuss words (most beginning with the letter ‘F’) were uttered under her breath in front of both me and my wife. The manner in which she conducted herself was neither professional nor appropriate.

In the end, I was told that the incorrect charges would be refunded to my membership account. My confidence however after this experience is not very high as to where or even IF I will receive these charges back.

I have never had issues at other stores using my AccuBlue credits. The level of incompetence in processing our transaction and the attitude displayed by the employee was the most shockingly disappointing experience I’ve had at Leslie’s.

If the owner/manager of this store can contact me, I would appreciate it because I would like to have some confidence that I will be receiving my credits back. If for some reason I do not receive my credits back, I would appreciate other options be investigated.
reviews.author: Dan & Ashley

reviews.text: They will sell you expensive parts but when it comes time to get some technical support on the products don't bother calling.  They wont except your call or call you back.  They will only communicate with you via email.  End of story.
reviews.author: neal steinbrecher

reviews.text: Alice was very nice and helpful in getting my pool filter grid installed to allow me to get pool system back up and running!
reviews.author: Jeff Morgan

reviews.text:
Not one to complain but if I can save someone the headache of dealing with rude or high prices.
Came in to find a plastic part. Employee tells me it's $45. I politely declined & apologize for wasting his time then he proceeds to tell me I'll find it online for $37. I leave get on Amazon & find 2 of them for $12. Price gouging should be illegal.
reviews.author: Olgalydia Longoria

reviews.text: This is by far the best location in the HEB, colleyville, grapevine area. I am new to owning a pool and had so many questions. Jesus, the associate working the day I came in, walked me through everything I needed to know to maintain a pool. He gladly answered all of my questions and gave me all of my options. He is very knowledgeable. While I was at the store, a guy from another pool company (down the street) even came in to ask a question and buy a part! I was very impressed with this location. I have had mediocre experiences at other Leslie locations, but now the Hurst location will be my go to.
reviews.author: Kristina Schmidt

reviews.text: Probably a great place if you have a large in ground pool. We have a small above ground pool and I basically have felt they aren't really invested in my business. Not only do they not really carry the right supplies for it but they aren't that helpful in resolving my issues with it. I can find supplies at Walmart or Target or Academy, but it would be nice to find solutions.
reviews.author: Rusty Ivey

reviews.text:
Only want to say.. wow.. on the customer service.. Jackson and all the others have been so very helpful to my husband and I.. we grew up with pools.. but with all the technology and fancy stuff now it’s a bit confusing to me .. these guys are so patient with me and I’m probably sure they laugh but when you have a new pool in all those fancy stuff, I’m sure they understand… every time I go in to this store.. always someone says hi … if I could give 10 stars We would…
Blessings and love to our pool experts…
God Bless..
The Fox Family
reviews.author: Lisa Giddens

reviews.text: Some kong haired dude working there needs to be removed. I will NEVER walk into another Leslies store again. I have never seen anyone, who deals with the public, speak so rudely. What a joke. I was in there last week and the guy is on a total power trip over his precious store mask policy. I own 2 houses with pools and he just lost all my business. Whoever owns that crummy little store better start paying attention to the business this guy is costing him.
reviews.author: Rob Divers, RN

data.summary: The reviews for Texas Pool Supply appear largely authentic, depicting a typical retail experience with a mix of helpful and unhelpful staff. The low volume of reviews (93 total on Google) and the specific, varied complaints suggest these are real customer experiences. The primary issues are inconsistent customer service and support, not fraud or fake reviews.
fake_signals: One 5-star review mentions a competitor (Leslie's) by name, which is unusual for a store review
Some reviews are very old (4-7 years), which may not reflect current operations

negative_evidence: Review mentions refusal to provide phone support, only email

authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Alice, Jesus, Jackson, Sara(h))
